query: select case when rank <= $1 then referrer end as referrer, sum(views)::bigint as "views!", sum(thumbnail_views)::bigint as "thumbnail_views!" from (select r.referrer, sum(r.views) as views, sum(r.thumbnail_views) as thumbnail_views, row_number() over (order by sum(r.views) + sum(r.thumbnail_views) desc, r.referrer) as rank from file_referrer_views r join files f on f.id = r.file_id where $2::text is null or f.created_at >= now() - $2::text::interval group by r.referrer) as per_referrer group by 1 order by bool_or(rank > $1), sum(views) + sum(thumbnail_views) desc, 1
